text:
Anya Petrov: Quick RFC spin-up: minimal KMS-escrow pattern for on-prem/offline package signing. Need operator UX that rotates keys locally and allows recoverable wrapped-key escrow without exfiltrating private material.
Matt Cheng: Two modes: operator-HSM (customer holds key, we store wrapped blob) or split-escrow (shares split between customer and Redwood).
Julie Park: Strong preference for threshold release (Shamir or multisig) + hardware attestation. Single-blob escrow is too risky.
Samir Patel: Airgap flow idea: CI publishes manifest. Operator copies release -> offline admin signs with hardware token -> tool emits `escrow.json` + short USB recovery file. Keep blobs time-limited.
Julie Park: Minimal escrow.json fields we need: version, wrapped_key_b64, wrap_alg, signer_pub, expiry_iso, origin_manifest_sha256, attestation_b64.
Matt Cheng: Agent API sketch: POST /v1/escrow (accept metadata + attestation), GET /v1/escrow/:id (metadata only). Raw wrapped key returned only with multi-approval token + hardware-backed session.
ops-bot: escrow-schema v1 validated against schema.
Anya Petrov: Next steps: I'll write the RFC section with sequence diagram, threat model, and sample `recovery-instructions.txt`. Draft tomorrow morning. Thanks!
